sqlite_schema.name: metering
sqlite_schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE metering(
            id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, reservation TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, body BLOB NOT NULL)

sqlite_schema.name: overhead
sqlite_schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE overhead(
            key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, category TEXT NOT NULL, duration_us INTEGER NOT NULL)

sqlite_schema.name: reservations
sqlite_schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE reservations(
            id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, key TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, binding BLOB NOT NULL,
            run TEXT NOT NULL, stage TEXT NOT NULL, maximum BLOB NOT NULL,
            actual BLOB, receipt TEXT)

sqlite_schema.name: state
sqlite_schema.sql: CREATE TABLE state(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(id=1), stopped INTEGER NOT NULL)

sqlite_schema.name: store_identity
sqlite_schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE store_identity(
            campaign TEXT NOT NULL, store_id TEXT NOT NULL, prior_history_receipt TEXT NOT NULL)
